method.fullDecode: ffmpeg -v error -xerror -i proof.mp4 -f null -; completed without error
method.visualInspection: Individual original-resolution decoded PNG sequences, ordered within each contiguous window. No real-time playback attestation.

decision: No confirmed critical or important blocker in the inspected sequences. Sampled visual review only; does not certify photorealism, full-film temporal quality, or mechanical engineering fidelity.

shots.name: read-the-corner
observations: Complete roof, mirrors, front rally lamps and rear wing fit in frame. Smooth car-to-gravel movement and stable paint highlights.
Tight overhead framing provides little road-corridor or bend context; sampled images establish the car more clearly than the corner.

shots.name: commit
observations: Full front-three-quarter silhouette; lamps, roof scoop, wing and wheels remain visible. Wheel rotation and passing gravel/foliage demonstrate motion.
Raised rally stance and chunky tread read clearly; no sampled camera jump, arch/body pop or foreground obstruction.

shots.name: contact-patch
observations: Entire near front wheel stays visible. Spokes/disc rotate, caliper stays at its mounting position, and wheel/arch motion changes smoothly across midpoint sequence.

Soft displaced shadow and lack of a visually strong contact patch make the wheel appear suspended. This is a visual grounding concern, not a confirmed physical float. Separate numeric report has minimum carcass gaps -0.000444 to -0.000110 metres against analytic road height for frames137–144.
Closeup mostly shows tyre/brake, with limited visibility of the suspension hardware; cannot certify linkage function from these images.

shots.name: driver-input
observations: Helmet, torso, hands at wheel and boots at pedals stay within frame. Cage and transparent body intentionally overlay the driver.
No obvious limb disconnect or sampled sudden pose/camera pop. Input movement is subtle in these short windows; detailed ergonomic or force-path correctness is not established.

shots.name: traction-exit
observations: Complete rear-three-quarter silhouette with wing, rear lamps, exhaust and visible wheels. Continuous roadside and gravel translation with wheel rotation.
Paint remains stable. Stance and rear cage remain readable. No dust plume or strong gravel spray in these inspected frames; stylized clean presentation offers limited traction/drama cues.

cuts: All four expected hard changes of viewpoint are present at56,113,169,225. Two frames before and two after each cut inspected; no intervening black frame, unexpected extra angle, or duplicated transition found in those windows.

concerns.issue: Soft contact-shadow separation weakens perceived tyre grounding in wheel closeup. Numeric evidence rules out analytic-field float for midpoint137–144, but screen-space grounding remains unconvincing.
Tight overhead read-the-corner view gives little bend context in inspected frames.

knownStyleLimits: Faceted foliage, simple grass triangles and clean unmarked car/road feel game-like. No photoreal beauty certification.
56/300 frames were visually inspected; full decode is a technical check and does not substitute for all-frame visual inspection.
